title: One-Year Outcome of Intravitreal Tissue Plasminogen Activator, Ranibizumab, and Gas Injections for Submacular Hemorrhage in Polypoidal Choroidal Vasculopathy

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) license, Licensee MDPI)

condition: Thick foveal submacular haemorrhage (at least 2 disc diameters, symptoms for at most 30 days) secondary to polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy (nAMD subtype); one session of intravitreal rt-PA, ranibizumab and C3F8 gas with prone positioning, then intravitreal aflibercept PRN for recurrence; extended prospective single-centre study (Nihon University Hospital, 2014-2018), 64 eyes of 64 patients; 12-month follow-up

groups.agent: one session of intravitreal rt-PA (alteplase 25 µg/0.05 mL), ranibizumab 0.5 mg/0.05 mL and 100% C3F8 0.3 mL; aflibercept PRN for recurrence

series.notes: mean ± SD (Statistical analysis: data expressed as mean ± SD; paired t-tests); times from the treatment session (scheduled monthly visits); per-visit n not stated; four eyes had vitrectomy for complications within the first month and 46 eyes received aflibercept PRN for recurrence; their values were not reported as removed or replaced, so all visits are kept

exclusions.reason: pigment epithelial detachment thickness is not central retinal thickness

exclusions.what: Tables 2-3 (correlation and multivariate analyses) and Table 4 (literature comparison)
exclusions.reason: correlations, model results and other studies' counts are not admissible

notes: Visual acuity, CPEDT, displacement, recurrence and injection numbers are reported (not extracted).
Polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy is recorded under namd (protocol subtype rule).
Ambiguity resolved: the combined rt-PA, ranibizumab and gas session is one of the treatments in use and the study declares no experimental arm, so the group role is control.
Ambiguity resolved: regimen prn (one combined session, then aflibercept as needed for recurrence).
